procedure.title: Welcome & consent
procedure.note: Greet the participant, explain the study, and collect informed consent.

procedure.title: Demographics questionnaire
procedure.note: Short background questions (e.g. age range, AI familiarity).

procedure.title: Training / practice
procedure.note: Walk through the interface with a few practice trials so the task is understood before it counts.

procedure.title: Main task (trials)
procedure.note: The core trials where your dependent variables are collected, in the counterbalanced order from Study Design.

procedure.title: Debrief
procedure.note: Explain the study's purpose, answer questions, and thank the participant.

cognitiveParameters.label: Max Features Attended
cognitiveParameters.note: How many explanation features the simulated user attends to. The model itself defaults to all 12; 4 is the value that best matches the measured behaviour.

cognitiveParameters.label: Aggregation Strategy
cognitiveParameters.note: How evidence from the attended features is combined into a decision.

cognitiveParameters.label: Confidence Responsiveness
cognitiveParameters.note: Applies to all aggregation strategies. Lower = more responsive to the change. The backend accepts any float; −3.0 to 1.0 is the evidence-supported window, with the optimum at −1.5 (flat between −2.0 and −1.0), which is most accurate to the measured effect.
